text.p: The Bulgarian police arrested Hristo Alexandrov, founder and ex-director of the ailing Plovdiv-based Agrobusinessbank on charges of misapropriation, a police statement said on Friday.
"Alexandrov was arrested in connection with a case on sizeable misappropriation of funds," said the statement.
The central bank took full control of the private bank in November 1995, buying out 90 percent of its voting shares for one lev to save it from collapse.
The bank reported losses of 1.012 billion levs for the first half of 1995 and losses of 198 million levs for 1994.

Agrobusinessbank was founded three years ago by a group of private companies around businessmen Hristo Alexandrov, a former bartender and Hristo Danov, both of them members of the bank's former supervisory board.

Local media reports said Alexandrov continued driving his two luxurious Mercedes cars and a private Cesna airplane after the central bank take-over. He had also spent the last several months in Switzerland, the newspapers said.

Agrobusinessbank is one of 14 Bulgarian banks placed under special supervision by the central bank, which sought their bunkrutpcy in a move to protect their depositors and stabilise the crumbling financial system.
